name: Minecraft mods
instructions: The kids play these mods on the family Bedrock server. Keep a kid's mod small and fun: one new item, block, or effect, which they can get with a kit. Draw item and block pictures with the draw_picture tool (16x16), following the picture rules in CLAUDE.md. Do not commit, push, or restart the server yourself: Kidex blocks it. When the mod is done and its test passes, tell the kid how to play it: press the Start the server button (if it isn't running already), which puts new mods in the game by itself in a minute (anyone playing gets kicked for a moment), and then, in the server screen, get it with the kit menu (the k key).

actions.prompt: Make a new mod (start with npm run new).

The kid wants something that isn't a new mod or a change to one mod: say a new kit (like more building materials, in kits/, see CLAUDE.md), a change to several mods, or to mc and mc dev. Do what they ask, keep it small, and check it with npm run validate and npm test (and ./mc test <mod> for a mod you changed). New kits show up in the server screen's kit menu (the k key) after the server screen restarts.
The kid has a question about the mods or Minecraft. Answer it; do not change any files.

kit.json.en: What you get when you try the mod
kit.json.da: Det du får, når du prøver modet

item_texture.json.en: A list that tells the game which picture goes with which item
item_texture.json.da: En liste der fortæller spillet hvilket billede der hører til hvilken ting

textures/.en: A picture the game paints on the item
textures/.da: Et billede spillet maler på tingen

behavior_pack/items/.en: A new item: its name and what it can do
behavior_pack/items/.da: En ny ting: dens navn og hvad den kan

scripts/.en: Code the game runs: this is where the magic happens
scripts/.da: Kode som spillet kører: her sker magien

texts/.en: The names players see in the game
texts/.da: De navne spillerne ser i spillet
